summary: Cloudflare reported a network spanning more than 330 cities in over 125 countries and interconnecting with more than 13,000 networks.
analyst_note: Company-reported footprint; independent utilization and traffic-share data are not disclosed.

summary: Running application services, SASE and developer products on one global software stack can lower customer complexity and create cross-sell and scope economies.
analyst_note: Inference from company architecture and product disclosures; customer-level TCO is not disclosed.

summary: Q2 2026 revenue was $696.061M, up 36% year over year; H1 revenue was $1.336B, up 35%.
analyst_note: Unaudited interim financial statements filed with the SEC.

summary: Customers with more than $100,000 in Annualized Revenue increased to 4,698 from 3,712, or about 26.6% year over year.
analyst_note: Annualized Revenue multiplies quarterly revenue by four and may exceed actual annual revenue.

summary: Dollar-based net retention was 120% in Q2 2026 versus 114% in Q2 2025.
analyst_note: DBNR includes expansion net of contraction and attrition but excludes new customers.

summary: Total RPO was $2.732B with 64% expected in the next 12 months; Cloudflare reported Current RPO growth of 35% year over year.
analyst_note: RPO is contracted consideration, not guaranteed cash realization; timing and cancellations can differ by contract.

summary: Q2 and H1 GAAP gross margin declined to about 72% from about 75%; H1 cost of revenue grew 56% versus 35% revenue growth.
analyst_note: Management attributed cost growth to third-party technology services, colocation/network/bandwidth and depreciation.

summary: H1 company-defined FCF was $140.458M, up 63% from $86.147M; Q2 FCF was $56.384M versus $33.280M.
analyst_note: FCF equals OCF less purchases of property and equipment and capitalized internal-use software; it does not deduct SBC.

signal: TTM cash flow and SBC burden
summary: TTM revenue, FCF and SBC are estimated at $2.512B, $314.873M and $507.655M; SBC equals 20.2% of revenue and 161% of company-defined FCF.
source: Calculation from a78462fd-2bd0-4c99-be0e-144df3a1a44d.pdf pp. 79-82, 98-101 and 5fbf0918-bf12-46f0-bde1-a4453b220af0.pdf pp. 10, 14, 40-42
analyst_note: TTM equals FY2025 plus H1 2026 less H1 2025. SBC is an economic cost even when non-cash in the current period.

summary: Period-end Class A plus Class B shares rose to 355.931M from 351.887M at December 2025, about 1.1% in six months; FY2026 non-GAAP EPS guidance uses about 374M diluted shares.
analyst_note: The diluted guidance count includes potential employee awards and convertible effects and is not directly comparable to period-end basic shares.

summary: Cash and available-for-sale securities totaled $4.163B at Q2 end versus $3.270B carrying value of convertible notes; the $1B revolving facility was undrawn.
analyst_note: The 2026 notes matured after quarter-end and a new $2.5B 2031 issue changed the subsequent capital structure.

summary: Cloudflare announced an approximately 20% workforce reduction, estimated charges up to $165M and recognized $150.693M in H1.
analyst_note: The plan may improve efficiency but creates execution, culture, security and control risks until post-restructuring KPIs are observed.

summary: Cloudflare acquired VoidZero for $164.2M, including $98.7M of stock, and entered $106.4M of post-combination stock-compensation arrangements.
analyst_note: Strategically fits the developer platform, but acquisition-level revenue and return data were not presented.

summary: The 2026 proxy reported 39.0% voting power for Matthew Prince and 13.4% for Michelle Zatlyn, 52.4% combined.
analyst_note: Voting control is much larger than the founders' economic ownership because Class B carried ten votes per share.

signal: Class C and Series FF governance changes
summary: Stockholders approved elements of a structure using non-voting Class C stock and nine-vote non-economic Series FF preferred stock to preserve founder control; the structure has no fixed time sunset.
analyst_note: Service and capital-at-risk conditions plus enhanced independent-director provisions partially mitigate the entrenchment risk.

summary: Eight purported stockholder complaints sought to enjoin the capitalization changes; seven were consolidated and alleged that founder control and liquidity were preserved without sufficient consideration.
analyst_note: These are unadjudicated allegations, not established misconduct; Cloudflare and its board stated the claims lack merit.

summary: Cloudflare issued $2.5B of 0% convertible notes due 2031 at a $496.94 initial conversion price and spent $259.5M on capped calls with an $854.12 initial cap.
analyst_note: The financing increases liquidity at low cash interest but introduces future cash-settlement and dilution choices.

signal: Co-founder planned option exercise and sale
summary: Michelle Zatlyn exercised and sold 99,009 shares over August 19-21 under a Rule 10b5-1 plan adopted February 27, 2026.
analyst_note: Planned selling is not by itself evidence of thesis deterioration and was small relative to her Class B holdings.

summary: At $281.44 and $99.724B market cap, a 9.5% discount rate, 3% terminal growth, 1.5% annual dilution and 30% year-10 FCF margin require about 34.2% ten-year revenue CAGR and $47.7B year-10 revenue.
analyst_note: Reverse DCF is an estimate and highly sensitive to terminal margin, discount rate and dilution.

summary: Bear/Base/Bull values are estimated at $30/$110/$260; subjective 30%/50%/20% probabilities imply about $116 per share, 59% below market.
analyst_note: Even the realistic Bull scenario is below the current price; this triggers the price-requires-unrealistic-bull-case veto.

summary: Cloudflare is a strong platform candidate, but the current expectation gap and downside asymmetry do not justify a new position.
analyst_note: Opinion follows a price Hard Veto FAIL; macro and price action alone did not change the company-quality score.
